program: Additional targeted overdose-prevention outreach and naloxone distribution
amountSemantics: modeled marginal donor expenditure, not a verified funding offer

plannedCostAnchor.semantics: proposed ongoing bundled budget and target outputs; not executed accounts or marginal rates

judgments.label: Donor cost per additional dose
judgments.basis: $20 is approximately twice the $9.61 planned bundle/target-dose benchmark, rounded, allowing extra outreach effort and delivery shortfalls. This transfers across years and program scopes; it is not an SFAF quote.

judgments.label: Share of reported yield retained at the margin
judgments.basis: 50% is an aggregate judgment for harder-to-reach expansion, displacement, reporting/denominator mismatch and repeated recipients. These components are not separately measured; a person-linked model is needed to resolve repeat-rescue double counting.

judgments.label: Additional acute survival per retained reversal
judgments.basis: 2% credits one additional acute survivor per 50 retained reports. Most reported reversals are assumed not to be additional lives saved because spontaneous survival and alternative rescue are possible. Historical untreated-overdose model inputs provide plausibility, not a current local counterfactual.

judgments.label: Health utility during survival
judgments.basis: 0.70 is an explicit downward transfer from a 2024 patient-data estimate of 0.799 for HIV-negative daily heroin injection, allowing comorbidity and current-population differences. It is not a judgment about a person's moral worth.

judgments.label: Annual all-cause mortality hazard
judgments.basis: 0.08 is informed by a US overdose-survivor cohort's 778.3 deaths per 10,000 person-years. Keeping this rate constant is an approximation, not an observed 15-year SF trajectory.

judgments.label: Credited survival horizon
judgments.basis: 15 years truncates benefits because current recipient ages and long-term outcomes are unknown. This is a judgment, not a life-expectancy estimate.

judgments.label: Annual QALY discount
judgments.basis: 3% is an explicit model convention; applied as an effective annual discount rate.

survivalFormula: utility * (1 - exp(-(annualHazard + log(1 + discountRate)) * horizonYears)) / (annualHazard + log(1 + discountRate))
nullBoundary: If donations replace existing provision or no otherwise-fatal events are reached, additional QALYs are zero and there is no finite price. The positive scenarios are not confidence intervals and do not exclude null benefit.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: A current additional outreach plan, executed program costs, unmet coverage and recipient-linked rescue records; no contact with the organization has been made.

excluded: Healthcare costs after rescue and future healthcare spending
